examples.example: You will need — A coloured paper (30 cm long and 20 cm wide) and eight paper strips of two different colours (3 cm wide and longer than 20 cm). (a) Take a coloured paper 30 cm long and 20 cm wide. (b) Fold the coloured paper in half along the longer side. (c) Draw vertical lines at equal distances from the closed end and cut slits leaving a gap of 3 cm at the top. (d) Carefully unfold the paper.
